Package index

Data Preparation

Prepare genotypic data objects for analysis. Use primeCross() for biparental mapping populations and the checkPanel() / filterPanel() / primePanel() workflow for diversity panels.

primeCross()
Prepare a Cross Object for Whole-Genome Analysis
fixMap()
Collapse Co-located Markers to Consensus Genotypes
checkPanel()
Check a Marker Panel for Data Quality Issues
print(<checkPanel>)
Print a checkPanel summary
filterPanel()
Filter a Marker Panel by Data Quality Thresholds
print(<filteredPanel>)
Print a filteredPanel summary
primePanel()
Prepare Marker Panel Data for Whole-Genome Analysis for gwasAim and gpAim

QTL Mapping Pipeline

Forward-selection whole-genome QTL detection in biparental mapping populations. Supports univariate and multivariate multi-environment (G×E) models.

qtlAim()
QTL Analyses via Integrated Modelling
print(<qtlAim>)
Print a Fitted qtlAim Object
summary(<qtlAim>)
Summary of a Fitted qtlAim Model
plot(<qtlAim>)
Plot a Fitted qtlAim Object

GWAS Pipeline

Forward-selection genome-wide association analysis in diversity panels. Supports univariate and multivariate multi-environment models.

gwasAim()
GWAS Analyses via Integrated Modelling
print(<gwasAim>)
Print a Fitted gwasAim Object
summary(<gwasAim>)
Summary of a Fitted gwasAim Model
plot(<gwasAim>)
Plot a Fitted gwasAim Object

Genomic Prediction & Selection Pipeline

Genomic best linear unbiased prediction (G-BLUP) and selection indexing. gpAim() delivers GEBVs and accuracies; selIndex() combines per-environment GEBVs into an optimised selection index.

gpAim()
Genomic Prediction via Integrated Modelling
print(<gpAim>)
Print a Fitted gpAim Object
summary(<gpAim>)
Summary of a Fitted gpAim Model
plot(<gpAim>)
Plot a Fitted gpAim Object
selIndex()
Selection Index for Genomic Prediction Objects
print(<selIndex>)
Print a selIndex Object
summary(<selIndex>)
Summary of a selIndex Object
plot(<selIndex>)
Plot a selIndex Object

plot(<fineMap>)

Stack QTL summary tables from multiple fitted models

Print an aimTable Object
aimTrace()
Trace the forward-selection algorithm
getQTL()
Extract QTL position information from a fitted model
linkMap()
Plot a Genetic Linkage Map (Generic)

linkMap(<gwasAim>)

Datasets

Paired genotype/phenotype datasets from biparental wheat populations and a simulated multi-environment population, included for use in examples and vignettes.

genoRxK
Genotypic marker data for RAC875 x Kukri doubled haploid population in R/qtl format
phenoRxK
Phenotypic RAC875 x Kukri trial data frame
genoCxR
Genotypic marker data for Cascades x RAC875-2 doubled haploid population in R/qtl format
phenoCxR
Phenotypic Cascades x RAC875-2 zinc experiment data frame
genoSxT
Genotypic marker data for Sunco x Tasman doubled haploid population in R/qtl format
phenoSxT
Phenotypic Sunco x Tasman trial data frame
genoMVsim
Simulated DH genotype data for multivariate QTL mapping
phenoMVsim
Simulated phenotypic data for multivariate QTL mapping
genoGWASraw
Simulated raw marker data for a diversity panel
mapGWASsim
Genetic map for the simulated diversity panel
phenoGWASsim
Simulated multi-environment trial phenotypes for the diversity panel
